question: What devours bound souls and brings the world into its belly?
premises: mass of bound souls is devoured
moving and unmoving world is brought inward
inference: The power devours bound souls from Ananta to Brahma and draws the whole world into its own belly-cave.
plain_english: Devouring the mass of bound souls from Ananta to Brahma, it has brought the moving and unmoving world into the cave of its own belly.
